name: Patrick Deneen

lean.basis: Leading "post-liberal" conservative theorist; his 2023 book Regime Change calls for replacing the bipartisan establishment with a new elite serving the common good; launched it with JD Vance and Heritage president Kevin Roberts; regular NatCon speaker.

current_role: Professor of political science, University of Notre Dame
summary: Patrick Deneen is a Notre Dame political theorist whose Why Liberalism Failed (2018), recommended by Barack Obama, argued that liberalism erodes community and meaning. His follow-up Regime Change: Toward a Postliberal Future (2023) was launched at a panel with JD Vance and Kevin Roberts, and Vance has borrowed its "anti-regime" language. He has spoken at NatCon in 2019, 2021 and 2025.
